t: A credit-card sized RISC-V computer with an AI chip that runs Ubuntu.
steps: Buy the board from the ESWIN store on Amazon. The bundle with a heatsink is the easier pick.
Get a USB-C PD power adapter that can give 15 V at 3 A, plus a microSD card.
Download the matching bootloader and Ubuntu 24.04 image from the ESWIN ebc7700-sbc-ubuntu repo.
Connect the micro USB debug port to your computer and open a serial terminal.
Follow the flashing guide in the repo to update the bootloader from the U-Boot shell.
Write the Ubuntu image to the microSD card and boot the board.
Log in over the serial console and run a first Python script.
Install a desktop by hand for a monitor and keyboard setup.
meta: Open Code. From $202. A few stores.
